## Changes

### Added
- Bahasa Indonesia: pick the app's language in More → Appearance → Language. English stays the default, and the app switches at once, without a restart. Comic titles, synopses and other text from sources are shown as the source sends them.

### Changed
- Counts read naturally in each language, e.g. "1 comic" and "3 comics" in English, "3 komik" in Indonesian.
